findings.evidence: All dependencies are in Parameters.lean: `structure Parameters` (45), `weakMixingConsistency` (124), `electricChargeConsistency` (128), `cos2ThetaW` (222), `electricCharge_sq_eq_gSU2_sq_mul_sin2ThetaW` (240). `grep -n zToPhotonRatio` in the new file shows occurrences only at 41-42 (docstring) and 133-157 (its own def/lemmas) — no use in `neutralCurrent_def` or the term definitions.
findings.fix: Move the four declarations into `PVES/Electroweak/Parameters.lean` (or a new `PVES/Electroweak/` module importing only it) and keep the cross-section file as the consumer.
findings.issue: `zToPhotonRatio`, `zToPhotonRatio_def`, `zToPhotonRatio_eq`, `zToPhotonRatio_nonneg` are generic `Electroweak`-namespace declarations about the Z/photon propagator-and-coupling ratio, placed in a cross-section file four import levels downstream; they are unused by every cross-section definition here (`neutralCurrent` and the three terms take `η : ℝ` as a bare argument), so reaching this basic electroweak quantity forces importing the whole DIS cross-section stack.

findings.evidence: `helicityCoupling` uses `c.gV`, `c.gA`, `gR_def`, `gL_def` (Parameters.lean:61-83) and `helicitySign` (Interference/Basic.lean:33); `grep -rn helicityCoupling code/` matches only the new file, all inside the `Electroweak.FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings` namespace section at lines 106-126.
findings.fix: Move the block to `PVES/Interference/Basic.lean`, the earliest file where both `FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings` and `helicitySign` are available; alternatively relocate `helicitySign` and this block together into `Electroweak/Parameters.lean` next to `gL`/`gR`.
findings.issue: `FermionNeutralCurrentCouplings.helicityCoupling` and its `_def`/`_true`/`_false` lemmas extend the generic coupling record of `Electroweak/Parameters.lean` with a chiral-projection fact (`= 2 g_R` / `2 g_L`); they depend only on that record plus `helicitySign`, not on any cross section, yet live in the cross-section file. Later roadmap items (§1.5 helicity decomposition, §2 asymmetries) would have to import this cross-section module to use them.

summary: Two blocks in the `Electroweak` namespace sit in a downstream cross-section file although they depend on nothing later than `Electroweak/Parameters.lean`; the propagator ratio is not even used by the cross sections in this file. Imports and the new subdirectory are fine.
